title: Plant Manager - EMS, PCBA & Semiconductor
text:
**Job Overview**

Lead plant operations across electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), and semiconductor production. You’ll connect production planning, quality, supply chain, and team leadership to keep work flowing safely, reliably, and in line with operational priorities.

**Duties**

* Direct daily manufacturing operations, production scheduling, and production management systems; align capacity, materials, and staffing with production plans.
* Your impact: By coordinating production, quality, and supply chain teams, you help customers receive dependable products and give employees clear priorities.
* Use SAP and other enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, material requirements planning (MRP), and Microsoft Excel data analysis to monitor performance, inventory, and supply chain analytics.
* Lead continuous improvement through Lean manufacturing, Lean management, Six Sigma, and process improvement practices; strengthen quality control and assembly processes.
* Develop team leaders, promote cross-functional communication, and manage plant performance, resources, and supply chain relationships.

**Requirements**

* Experience in plant management, manufacturing management, production management, or operations management in a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, assembly, production planning and scheduling, quality control, and supply chain management.
* Familiarity with SAP, MRP, ERP systems, and production management systems; ability to analyze operational data using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience applying continuous improvement, process improvement, Lean, Lean manufacturing, Lean management, or Six Sigma methods.
* Strong team leadership and cross-functional communication skills; supply chain analytics experience is preferred.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
